Name: Scaring - Thieving Skill
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
[size=3]This mod is no longer supported. The scaring - thieving skill mod will be split into two skills, instead of them being skins of the same skill. Stay tuned. [/size]



[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img][/size]
[size=3]Introduces a new mechanic to stardew valley, "Scaring/Thieving" that interacts with the social system in a whole new way. Loose friendship but have a chance to gain loot when interacting with giftable NPCS![/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]After talking with a giftable NPC once, You can go up to them and hit the Scare/Steal key (default: B .. for BOO!)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Many things affect how Terrifying/Sneaky you are such as; the direction you are vs the direction the NPC is, weather, if you're outside and it's dark out, daily luck, ect.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]You will loose friendship with them (who likes getting scared?) but they have a chance to drop an item they like or love.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]This counts as a gift for the week! You can only scare villagers twice per week.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Afterwards, the skill will go on cooldown.[/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]For those who don't want to terrorize the village, you can also scare/steal from monsters. This only gives 1/3rd the exp... but if you do well enough, it will push them back and deal 1 damage, while also an extra loot item![/size][/*]
[/list]
The idea of this mod came about wanting to scare villagers... but some one pointed out that the idea was close to stealing from them. So I added a config that reskins most of the mod into the thieving skill! For those who think that "scaring" is kinda silly and immersion breaking. The config option requires a restart to take effect.
[size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LGFY8Nd.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Level 5: Ghost / Pickpocket - Direction no longer affects the dice chance.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Level 10: Banshee / Highwayman - You now affect NPCs around you at once.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Level 10: Wraith / Mugger - You gain 25% of your max Health and Stamina when you Scare/Steal.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=3]Level 5: Zombie / Robin hood - Chance to not loose friendship when scaring/stealing.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Level 10: Vampire / Phantom - Universal Loves are now a possible chance to get from Scaring/Stealing[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Level 10: Ghoul / Rogue - Gain an extra 10% to your Scare/Stealing dice rolls, and to your loot rolls. [/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2tjtjDL.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Remove the Spooky: Changes the skill to the Thieving Skill when this is selected (default: false)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Thief skill page icon: Changes the icon of the Thief skill when the above is true (default: 1).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Monsters Only: Change to true (check mark it) to make it so you can only scare/steal from monsters. (default: false)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Action Key: The keybind you press to Scare/Steal[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Global EXP modifier: This changes the overall exp you get from the skill (default: 1)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]EXP from a fail: The exp you get when you completely fail to scare/Steal. (default: 1)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Exp from a tier 1 success: How much exp you get at a tier 1 success (default: 8)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Exp from a tier 2 success: How much exp you get at a tier 2 success (default: 16)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Exp from a tier 3 success: How much exp you get at a tier 3 success (default: 24)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Exp from a tier 4 success: How much exp you get at a tier 4 success (default: 32)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eg7jJbF.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/174]All Professions[/url]: All custom skill professions should be compatible with All professions.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿: With the switch to content patcher, all items should correctly show up with the item patcher.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Mastery (vanilla mastery): Scaring/Thieving does not have any mastery, but exp gained from Scaring/Thieving will contribute to mastery levels after the player unlocks it.﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases]UI infosuite 2[/url]: Does not support custom skills, you will not see custom skill exp gained from it. Please use one of the other options below...[/size].
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11089]Xp Display[/url]: Will show custom archaeology gained exp. This mod also has custom hooks into it's API to make it so the Hoe and Pan count as Archaeology tools.﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22751]Abilities - Experience Bars[/url]﻿: Will show custom skills exp gain and show them as bars.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/509]Experience Bars[/url]﻿: Should be compatible with all custom skills[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][size=3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dMGE7uv.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]More items that effect scaring?[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Maybe a machine of some type that auto scares/steals from villagers who walk past it?[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NaNmbIk.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]If you want to help out with making the skill better, please do! I am also looking to commission people for the following things (tho if you just want to help, that is also fine)[/size][/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*][size=3]Improve the base code/optimizations[/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]You can find the[url=https://github.com/Pet-Slime/StardewValley/tree/master/SpookySkillCode] [/url][url=https://github.com/Pet-Slime/StardewValley/tree/master/ExcavationSkill]github here[/url]﻿ ﻿to open pull requests[/size][/*]
[/list]
 [i][size=5][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/SkgptFd.png[/img][/size][/size][/i]
[size=3]Install required mods[i].
[/i]Download, unzip, and place the SpookySkill folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.
If installed on an existing file, the new professions should be immediately available.[/size]
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android.
